Policies and Initiatives.title: Gen AI startup Neysa turns unicorn after Blackstone-led $1.2 Bn funding
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Neysa, a Mumbai-based AI acceleration cloud platform, has raised over $1.2 billion in funding led by Blackstone, becoming a unicorn. The funding includes $600 million in equity capital and plans for an additional $600 million in debt financing. This marks one of the largest capital raises in India's AI infrastructure space, with other investors including Teachers' Venture Growth and Nexus Venture Partners.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Maharashtra govt to hold Artificial Intelligence in Agriculture and Investment Summit on Feb 22
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Maharashtra government will host an Artificial Intelligence in Agriculture and Investment Summit on February 22. The event is part of the state's Agriculture Artificial Intelligence policy, which aims to promote AI use in agriculture and allied sectors. The policy also involves developing digital infrastructure, including MahaAgriX, a Maharashtra Agriculture Data Exchange, and AI-enabled traceability systems.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Before the first missiles fly: AI, cyber & electronic warfare - how India is preparing for invisible battlefields
Policies and Initiatives.summary: India is integrating AI, cyber, and electronic warfare into its military, shifting towards a process-centric doctrine. This integration, as seen in Operation Sindoor, aims to enhance intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance capabilities. The goal is to achieve strategic dominance and reduce reliance on foreign technology in future conflicts.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Mumbai to Host World’s First AI GCC Hub as Maharashtra & Supervity AI Sign Landmark MoU at Davos
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Mumbai will host the world's first AI GCC Hub after Maharashtra and Supervity AI signed a landmark MoU at Davos. The state will support talent enablement, including training up to 25,000 AI engineers over time. This initiative aims to establish Mumbai as a major AI hub, driven by the partnership between Maharashtra and Supervity AI.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Nagpur airport may get AI facial recognition to identify criminals
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Nagpur airport is considering the implementation of AI facial recognition technology to identify and detect criminals. The technology aims to enhance security measures at the airport by using artificial intelligence to recognize and match faces with existing databases. This move is part of efforts to improve safety and security at the airport.

Events.title: Transforming Customer Experiences with Agentic AI
Events.summary: Agentic AI is being utilized to transform customer experiences. The development is taking place in Mumbai, where the technology is being implemented to enhance customer interactions. This innovative approach aims to revolutionize the way companies engage with their customers through AI-driven solutions.

Events.title: DPDP and Enterprise AI
Events.summary: A recent event in Mumbai focused on the intersection of DPDP (Data Protection and Digital Privacy) and Enterprise AI. The discussion highlighted the importance of balancing data privacy with the implementation of artificial intelligence in businesses. Key stakeholders gathered to explore the challenges and opportunities of integrating AI in enterprises while ensuring compliance with DPDP regulations.

Events.title: Jio to launch people-first Al platform - Here's what Reliance's Chairman Mukesh Ambani said
Events.summary: Reliance Industries' Chairman Mukesh Ambani announced Jio's India-built AI platform at the Vibrant Gujarat conference. The platform aims to provide citizens access to AI in local languages, enhancing daily efficiency and productivity. This people-first AI platform is designed to make AI more accessible to the general public.

Major AI Developments.title: ZP Budget Crosses ₹50 Crore Mark For First Time, Solar, AI & Rural Infra In Focus
Major AI Developments.summary: The ZP budget has exceeded ₹50 crore for the first time, with a focus on solar energy, artificial intelligence, and rural infrastructure development. This significant increase in budget allocation is expected to drive growth and improvement in these key areas. The new budget prioritizes innovative technologies like AI and renewable energy sources like solar power.

Major AI Developments.title: BFSI Tech Conclave 2026 | 19th & 20th June 2026
Major AI Developments.summary: The BFSI Tech Conclave 2026 is scheduled to take place on June 19th and 20th, 2026. The event will be held at the Radisson Blu Plaza Resort & Convention Centre in Karjat, Maharashtra, India. The conclave will bring together professionals to discuss technology in the banking, financial services, and insurance sectors.

Major AI Developments.title: Why Real-Time Data Streaming is the True Foundation for the AI era
Major AI Developments.summary: Real-time data streaming is considered the foundation for the AI era, enabling instant decision-making and action. This technology allows for the immediate processing and analysis of vast amounts of data, driving AI applications forward. In Mumbai, the importance of real-time data streaming is being recognized as a key component of AI development.

Major AI Developments.title: From prototype to production: How developers can make agentic AI reliable
Major AI Developments.summary: Anannya Roy of AWS emphasized the importance of observability, evaluation frameworks, and human oversight in making autonomous AI systems reliable. These elements are crucial for transitioning agentic AI from prototype to production. Roy discussed this topic at DevSparks Pune 2026, highlighting the need for a robust approach to ensure production-ready AI systems.

Major AI Developments.title: Digital lending marketplace Finfinity raises $2.4 Mn in seed round
Major AI Developments.summary: Finfinity, a digital lending marketplace, has raised $2.4 million in a seed funding round led by Mankind Pharma Promoter's Family Office. The funding round also saw participation from several other investors, including Vi-John Group and individual investors. The raised capital will be used to enhance Finfinity's technology platform, expand partnerships, and scale its operations.

Major AI Developments.title: Magical Nest operator Raanro raises pre-seed round
Major AI Developments.summary: Raanro Interior Technology, the parent company of Magical Nest, has raised Rs 4.12 crore in a pre-seed funding round at a pre-money valuation of Rs 60 crore. The round was participated by Stargazer Fund and several angel investors, including Kunal Shah and Ankit Nagori. The company will use the funds to develop an AI-powered platform for streamlining interior design workflows.

Major AI Developments.title: Neuro-rehabilitation startup Rymo Technologies secures Rs 10 Cr in seed round
Major AI Developments.summary: Rymo Technologies, a robotic neuro-rehabilitation startup, has secured Rs 10 crore in a seed funding round led by IAN Group. The funds will be used to drive product innovation, expand manufacturing, and strengthen the company's presence in India and internationally. The startup, co-founded in 2020, aims to scale into markets including ASEAN and the Middle East.

Major AI Developments.title: Unlocking Real-Time Intelligence using AI | 18th March 2026 | Mumbai
Major AI Developments.summary: An event titled "Unlocking Real-Time Intelligence using AI" is scheduled to take place on March 18th, 2026, in Mumbai. The event will be held at the Jio World Convention Centre, located in the Bandra Kurla Complex. The conference aims to explore the potential of AI in unlocking real-time intelligence.

Major AI Developments.title: Rethinking GenAI development with NVIDIA DGX Spark at DevSparks 2026
Major AI Developments.summary: NVIDIA's Sunil Patel showcased DGX Spark at DevSparks 2026, highlighting its ability to enable local prototyping and fine-tuning of large AI models. This capability dramatically reduces infrastructure barriers for developers, making it easier to work with GenAI. DGX Spark was demonstrated in Pune at the DevSparks 2026 event.

Major AI Developments.title: 165 women cops using AI to register routine complaints within minutes
Major AI Developments.summary: 165 women police officers are utilizing AI technology to register routine complaints in a matter of minutes. This innovative approach aims to streamline the complaint registration process, increasing efficiency and reducing wait times. The AI-powered system enables quick and convenient registration of complaints, improving overall police services.

Major AI Developments.title: In AI Age, Adaptability Is Key: VIP MD To Students
Major AI Developments.summary: A VIP MD recently addressed students, emphasizing the importance of adaptability in the age of artificial intelligence. The MD encouraged students to be flexible and open to new technologies and changes. This advice is crucial for students to thrive in a rapidly evolving job market dominated by AI.

Major AI Developments.title: Maharashtra to adopt AI solutions to tackle human-animal conflict: Forest Minister Ganesh Naik
Major AI Developments.summary: Maharashtra's Forest Minister Ganesh Naik has announced plans to adopt AI solutions to address human-animal conflict in the state. The initiative aims to mitigate the growing issue of encounters between humans and wild animals. The use of AI technology is expected to help reduce conflicts and promote coexistence between humans and animals.

Major AI Developments.title: From pilots to production: What it really takes to scale AI in GCCs
Major AI Developments.summary: Leaders from various companies, including Vertiv, NielsenIQ, and XPO, discussed the challenges of scaling AI at a recent roundtable in Pune. The key hurdles to overcome include infrastructure, governance, and talent acquisition. These challenges must be addressed to transition AI from experimentation to enterprise-scale deployment.

Major AI Developments.title: Neeri-developed AI tool maps vehicular pollution
Major AI Developments.summary: Researchers at Neeri have developed an AI tool that maps vehicular pollution, utilizing artificial intelligence to track and analyze pollution caused by vehicles. The tool aims to provide insights into pollution patterns and help mitigate its effects. The development is a significant step towards addressing environmental concerns related to vehicular emissions.

Major AI Developments.title: PMC to explore AI to detect unassessed properties, increase tax revenue
Major AI Developments.summary: The Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) plans to utilize Artificial Intelligence (AI) to identify unassessed properties and boost tax revenue. This initiative aims to increase the city's tax collection by detecting properties that are not currently paying taxes. The PMC will explore AI technology to achieve this goal and enhance its revenue streams.

Major AI Developments.title: Doctors warn against self-medicating with weight-loss injectables
Major AI Developments.summary: Doctors are warning against self-medicating with weight-loss injectables, citing the risk of serious side effects. These injectables, known as GLP-1 drugs, are effective for weight loss but require prescription and supervision from endocrinologists or bariatric physicians. Experts are calling for tighter regulation due to unsupervised and cosmetic use of these potent medications.

Major AI Developments.title: VR & AI reshape shoulder surgical training in Pune
Major AI Developments.summary: Orthopaedic surgeons in Pune are utilizing VR headsets and AI to enhance shoulder surgical training, with VR platforms allowing practice on 3D models in virtual operating rooms. AI-powered systems aid in pre-operative planning by analyzing scans and simulating surgical designs, improving patient safety. This integration of VR and AI technology aims to enhance surgeons' skills and decision-making capabilities.

Major AI Developments.title: Reliance on borrowed algorithms for AI could cost India its autonomy: Former foreign secretary
Major AI Developments.summary: Former foreign secretary warns that India's reliance on borrowed algorithms for AI could compromise its autonomy. This over-reliance may hinder India's ability to make independent decisions and maintain control over its technological advancements. India's use of foreign algorithms could ultimately undermine its sovereignty in the field of artificial intelligence.

Major AI Developments.title: Art of building local AI systems with NVIDIA DGX Spark: Decode with RP Tech, an NVIDIA partner
Major AI Developments.summary: NVIDIA DGX Spark is being utilized to build local AI systems through masterclasses hosted by DevSparks Pune and RP Tech, an NVIDIA partner. These masterclasses aim to redefine how AI is built, deployed, and owned. The collaboration focuses on addressing common AI development challenges such as rising costs and latency.

Major AI Developments.title: BFSI leaders to chart the AI-first roadmap for 2026
Major AI Developments.summary: BFSI technology leaders will gather at the 10th ETBFSI CIO Digital Conclave to discuss the future of finance with a focus on "AI Integration and Automation". The event will address key questions on AI governance, explainability, and cyber-resilience in the regulated industry. The conclave aims to chart an AI-first roadmap for 2026, exploring the evolving role of the CIO in an AI-driven enterprise.

Major AI Developments.title: DevSparks 2026 Pune: From prompt to production in the age of agentic AI
Major AI Developments.summary: AWS' Hands-on-Lab at DevSparks Pune 2026 will demonstrate how AI accelerates full-stack development, from idea to deployment. The event highlights the evolving Indian developer ecosystem, which requires advanced tools to keep pace. AI-powered tools are transforming software development, enabling faster deployment of applications.

Major AI Developments.title: IIM-Nagpur to use AI to set question papers, check answers
Major AI Developments.summary: IIM-Nagpur is implementing AI to set question papers and check answer scripts, aiming to reduce evaluation time from two weeks to a couple of days. AI will assist in initial grading, but human intervention will still be necessary for final assessment and to ensure creativity. The use of AI is expected to speed up the evaluation process while maintaining the importance of human judgment.

Major AI Developments.title: Klassroom files DRHP for SME IPO; revenue jumps 120% in FY25
Major AI Developments.summary: Klassroom, an edtech startup, has filed its Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) for an SME IPO on the Bombay Stock Exchange. The proposed IPO will consist of a fresh issue of equity shares and an offer-for-sale by existing shareholders. Klassroom's revenue has jumped 120% in FY25, and the IPO proceeds will be used for debt repayment, technology enhancement, and marketing initiatives.

Major AI Developments.title: India AI Impact Summit 2026: Maharashtra will ensure AI moves beyond pilot projects and reaches farmers, says CM Devendra Fadnavis
Major AI Developments.summary: Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis stated that the state will ensure AI technology moves beyond pilot projects and is implemented to benefit farmers. This announcement was made at the India AI Impact Summit 2026, highlighting the government's commitment to leveraging AI for agricultural development. The initiative aims to expand AI adoption beyond experimental stages and make a tangible impact on the farming community.

Major AI Developments.title: Bengaluru, Delhi-NCR account for over half of India’s AI job openings: Report
Major AI Developments.summary: Bengaluru, Delhi-NCR, and Mumbai account for nearly 70% of India's AI-related job openings. These cities have a high demand for skills in software engineering, data science, and customer operations. Bengaluru and Delhi-NCR alone account for over half of the country's AI job openings.

Major AI Developments.title: French President Macron begins India visit; AI summit and strategic ties in focus
Major AI Developments.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron has begun a three-day visit to India, focusing on artificial intelligence cooperation and innovation partnerships. The visit aims to strengthen strategic ties between the two countries. Macron's trip will explore opportunities for cooperation in AI and other areas of mutual interest.

Major AI Developments.title: Fractal Analytics makes muted market debut, lists at nearly 3% discount
Major AI Developments.summary: Fractal Analytics, an AI-focused analytics firm, made a subdued market debut, listing at a nearly 3% discount to its issue price. The company's shares opened at Rs 876 on the National Stock Exchange, below the upper end of its IPO price band of Rs 900. The muted debut follows a moderately subscribed IPO that booked nearly 2.66 times at the time of bid closure.

Major AI Developments.title: India needs to develop its own AI, says Shaurya Doval of India Foundation
Major AI Developments.summary: Shaurya Doval of India Foundation emphasizes the need for India to develop its own artificial intelligence. He believes this is essential for the country's growth and development. India should not rely on foreign AI technologies, according to Doval.

Major AI Developments.title: Maharashtra sharpens AI, cybersecurity push to anchor digital transformation
Major AI Developments.summary: Maharashtra is enhancing its focus on artificial intelligence (AI) and cybersecurity to drive digital transformation. The state aims to leverage AI and cybersecurity to anchor its digital transformation efforts, although specific details of the plan are not provided. Maharashtra's push for AI and cybersecurity is part of its broader strategy to embrace digital technologies.

Major AI Developments.title: DevSparks Pune 2026: What’s in store at India’s flagship developer summit?
Major AI Developments.summary: DevSparks, India's flagship developer summit, is returning to Pune in 2026 with a focus on agentic AI. The event will explore the transformational impact of AI across software development. Key discussions will center around the role of agentic AI in shaping the future of the industry.

Major AI Developments.title: Problem-solving ability will be the real strength of the future, says Dr. Tapan Singhel at IMDR’s 51st convocation ceremony
Major AI Developments.summary: Dr. Tapan Singhel emphasized the importance of problem-solving ability as the key strength for future success, particularly for young professionals. Despite AI's impact on entry-level roles, those with strong skills and innovative thinking will still find high-paying jobs. Dr. Singhel urged graduates to develop problem-solving abilities, learn from failure, and embrace opportunities for career success.

Major AI Developments.title: Three language policy panel submits report to Maharashtra CM, proposes AI and ICT education from Class 1
Major AI Developments.summary: A three-language policy panel has submitted a report to the Maharashtra Chief Minister, recommending the introduction of AI and ICT education from Class 1. The proposal aims to integrate technology into the curriculum from an early age, potentially enhancing students' skills in these areas. The report's submission marks a significant step towards potentially reforming the state's education system.

Major AI Developments.title: How GenAI is boosting engagement, skills and collaboration across teams
Major AI Developments.summary: Generative AI is being used by 95% of developers in Southeast Asia on a weekly basis, leading to higher engagement and productivity gains of up to 70%. This increased productivity is allowing for more time to be spent on upskilling, mentoring, and complex work. The adoption of GenAI is also improving global collaboration and helping to address talent shortages in the region.

Major AI Developments.title: NCP uses AI-generated voice, video of Ajit Pawar to make emotional pitch in zilla parishad polls; kicks off debate
Major AI Developments.summary: The Nationalist Congress Party (NCP) is using AI-generated voice and video clips of Ajit Pawar to make emotional appeals in zilla parishad polls. The clips mimic Pawar's voice and image, aiming to connect with voters by recalling his vision and endorsing trusted candidates. This tactic has sparked a debate over the ethical boundaries of using AI in political campaigning.

Major AI Developments.title: India Inc On The Move 2026: Leaders Decode the Next Phase of AI-Driven Manufacturing
Major AI Developments.summary: India Inc On The Move 2026 will take place in Mumbai on February 12, 2026, bringing together manufacturing leaders, technology innovators, and policy influencers. The event will focus on the future of Indian manufacturing, highlighting strategies and innovations in AI-driven manufacturing. The theme of the event is "The Future is Here: Smart, AI-Powered, Sustainable Manufacturing".

Major AI Developments.title: How Bharat Intelligence uses AI to solve farm labour crisis in Maharashtra’s villages
Major AI Developments.summary: Bharat Intelligence, a Mumbai-based agritech startup, is using AI to address the farm labour crisis in Maharashtra's villages. The company has developed a digital model of villages across the state, which its AI engine uses to deploy labourers to farmers with accuracy. This innovative approach aims to streamline the labour allocation process and support local farmers.

Major AI Developments.title: Persistent Extends Growth Run to 23 Quarters, Profit Slips 7% QoQ
Major AI Developments.summary: Persistent has extended its growth run to 23 quarters, with order bookings reaching $674.5 million in total contract value and $501.9 million in annual contract value. Despite this growth, the company's profit slipped 7% quarter-over-quarter. The company's consistent growth streak is a notable achievement in the industry.

Major AI Developments.title: Raana Semiconductors Raises $3 Mn Seed Funding for Silicon Ingot Systems
Major AI Developments.summary: Raana Semiconductors has raised $3 million in seed funding to develop silicon ingot systems. The company aims to reduce reliance on imported silicon ingots and wafers by enabling local manufacturing. This investment will support Raana Semiconductors' efforts to establish a domestic silicon production capability.

Major AI Developments.title: FireAI raises early-stage funding from IPV, VCats, and SucSEED Indovation
Major AI Developments.summary: FireAI, an AI analytics platform, has raised Rs 6.2 crore ($800K) in pre-seed and seed funding from investors including Inflection Point Ventures, Venture Catalyst, and SucSEED Indovation Fund. The startup has also launched a mobile decision intelligence app, with plans to use the funding to enhance its capabilities and scale infrastructure. The investment will further support the company's expansion and acceleration of enterprise adoption.

AI Start-Up News.title: AI made developers faster. So why are product teams still slow?
AI Start-Up News.summary: AI-driven coding tools have increased developer speed, but product teams remain slow due to limitations in implementing these gains at the team level. Anand Hariharan discussed this issue at DevSparks 2026, highlighting the need for context engineering and spec-driven development to bridge the gap. He proposed these approaches as solutions to fully leverage AI-driven coding benefits.

AI Start-Up News.title: Can AI help healthcare systems make sense of their data?
AI Start-Up News.summary: Gaurav Tripathi, Co-founder and Group CTO at Partex.AI, discussed how AI technologies can aid healthcare systems in analyzing medical data. Federated learning, knowledge graphs, and agentic AI are key solutions that can help institutions make sense of fragmented data. These technologies can achieve this goal without compromising patient privacy, according to Tripathi's presentation at DevSparks 2026 in Pune.

AI Start-Up News.title: Startup Infiheal bags honour at AI Impact Summit
AI Start-Up News.summary: Startup Infiheal received an honor at the AI Impact Summit, a recognition of its achievements in the field of artificial intelligence. The award acknowledges the company's innovative contributions to AI. Infiheal's win highlights its potential for growth and impact in the industry.

AI Start-Up News.title: This startup is bringing the benefits of AI to retail stock market investors
AI Start-Up News.summary: Mumbai-based startup InvestorAi has developed an AI-powered stock picking platform. The platform aims to assist retail investors in navigating the stock market. InvestorAi's technology is designed to provide benefits of AI to individual investors, helping them make informed decisions.

AI Start-Up News.title: Maharashtra poised to lead India’s public-sector AI adoption: Wadhwani AI
AI Start-Up News.summary: Maharashtra is expected to take the lead in India's public-sector adoption of artificial intelligence, according to Wadhwani AI. The state is poised to leverage AI for various public services and governance. Wadhwani AI anticipates Maharashtra to set an example for other states to follow in AI adoption.

AI Start-Up News.title: How this deeptech startup is driving seaweed cultivation along the western coast of India
AI Start-Up News.summary: ClimaCrew, a Mumbai-based deeptech startup, is promoting seaweed cultivation along India's western coast by partnering with coastal communities and industries. The company uses an AI-driven platform to analyze satellite data and identify suitable locations for seaweed cultivation. This initiative aims to harness the nutritional potential of seaweed in Gujarat and Maharashtra.

AI Start-Up News.title: Digital clinic Pinky Promise raises $1 Mn led by Rebalance Angel Community
AI Start-Up News.summary: Pinky Promise, an AI-led digital clinic for women, has raised $1 million in a pre-seed funding round led by Rebalance Angel Community. The funding will be used to accelerate integrated offerings, support physical clinics, and expand nutritional supplements. The company, co-founded in 2020 by Divya Kamerkar and Akanksha Vyas, aims to enable continuity of care at a national scale.
